title: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c:407: Transit Info parse rejects all valid messages
description: Line 407 requires data[0] (flags) == 0, but line 434 in write always sets flags=0x80 (E=1 per RFC 6550 6.7.8). Complete roundtrip failure: messages written by this module cannot be parsed by this module. Either parse should accept E=1 or write should not set it.
close_reason: Already fixed: Parse function (line 409) now requires data[0] == 0x80 matching write function (line 433). Roundtrip validated by test in lichen/tests/rpl_routing/src/main.c lines 76-109.
